{{- /* vendor/asset.html — emit one tag for a vendored third-party asset. Args (dict): path — local copy in the theme's assets/, e.g. "js/jquery.min.js" cdnUrl — CDN URL of the same asset assetType — "script" or "stylesheet" defer — bool (script only) Rules (site param allowCDN.vendor): false → the local copy is the only source; hard error if it is missing. true → the CDN is used when reachable at build time (tag emitted with an SRI integrity hash of the exact CDN bytes — never minified, so the browser's check matches); otherwise the local copy is used instead and a warning is logged. Hard error if neither source is available. Local copies are served as-is in development (easy to debug), minified and fingerprinted in every other environment, so a published build's CDN fallback is production-grade. */ -}} {{- $local := resources.Get .path -}} {{- $localOut := $local -}} {{- if ne hugo.Environment "development" }}{{- $localOut = $local | resources.Minify }}{{- end }} {{- if site.Params.allowCDN.vendor }} {{- $remote := try (resources.GetRemote .cdnUrl) }} {{- if $remote.Err }} {{- if not $local }} {{- errorf "vendor/asset: cannot fetch %q and no local copy of %q" .cdnUrl .path }} {{- else }} {{- warnf "vendor/asset: %s unreachable, using local %q" .cdnUrl .path }} {{- end }} {{- with $localOut | fingerprint }} {{- if eq $.assetType "script" }} {{- else }} {{- end }} {{- end }} {{- else }} {{- with $remote.Value | fingerprint }} {{- if eq $.assetType "script" }} {{- else }} {{- end }} {{- end }} {{- end }} {{- else }} {{- if not $local }} {{- errorf "vendor/asset: allowCDN is disabled but no local copy of %q" .path }} {{- end }} {{- with $localOut | fingerprint }} {{- if eq $.assetType "script" }} {{- else }} {{- end }} {{- end }} {{- end }}
